title: Vercel AI Gateway serves Reflection AI's Beam free for a limited launch period
detail: Vercel added Reflection AI's Beam to AI Gateway on October 16, 2026, free for a limited time during the launch period when served by Reflection AI. The changelog gives no end date and no price after the free period. It lists two identifiers: reflection/beam, which automatically moves to paid pricing with no downtime when the free period ends, and reflection/beam-free, which stops serving when the offer ends. The page states AI Gateway reflects provider pricing with no markup and no platform fee on inference, including bring-your-own-key requests.
impact: Usage of Beam costs nothing for now. When the offer ends, anything pinned to reflection/beam-free stops working, and anything on reflection/beam starts billing at a rate Vercel does not publish on this page and with no advance end date. Do not build a budget on the free rate.
